Name: Rabbit Floof
Author: DaisyNiko
Description:
[i]available in Chinese, Dutch, English, French, German, Hungarian, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, and Spanish! (other translations welcome)[/i]

sick and tired of your cute fluffy bunnies leaving their rotting limbs lying around? dreaming of a less creepy universal love that doesn't make you feel like a monster when you give it to people on their birthdays? well, look no further than Rabbit Floof™


[b]what the mod does:
[/b]
• changes the name, description, and sprite of the Rabbit's Foot object to make it a floof instead
• optionally removes Rabbit Floof from Penny's hated gifts, meaning she loves it the same as everyone else
[b]

how to install:[/b]

1. install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
2. extract the folder called [b][CP] Rabbit Floof[/b] to Stardew Valley/Mods
3. run the game with SMAPI and enjoy
